summary.en: Turning complex data into clear, rigorous, publishable insights — and making advanced statistics accessible across the Arab world.

biography.en:
I serve as a Teaching Assistant at the Sadat Academy for Management Sciences in Maadi, Cairo, and as a Research Assistant at the Faculty of Graduate Studies for Statistical Research, Cairo University, where I am also pursuing my PhD in Applied Statistics and Econometrics.

My research specializes in penalized estimators in count regression models — Ridge, Liu-type, and Beta regression methods for handling multicollinearity and high-dimensional data — and extends to panel-data and cointegration models, panel and logistic regression in R, and the reporting standards behind model-fit and normality testing. My work has been published in journals including Communications in Statistics, Frontiers in Applied Mathematics & Statistics, and Statistics, Optimization & Information Computing.

Beyond academia, I have completed over 450 statistical analysis reports for theses and papers, and founded the Statistical Analysis – Egypt community across Facebook and Telegram with over 550,000 combined members — making advanced statistics accessible across the Arab world.
